items.title: Henry A. "Hank" Kmen Interview, 1963-02-13
items.q: Jack Purvis, who I believe possibly was from New Orleans, also played a C melody sax.

ctx.x: And what inspired you to take up saxophone?

I always liked the pictures of saxophones in magazines. By this time you could hear a lot of it on the radio. I don't know who can explain these things, but I always had an affinity for the sound. I just really liked the sound of a sax or saxophones. There was an analogy too, isn't it? Yes, but it also sounded to me like much more than a novelty. I just liked the sound. I always had, so do. A good sax choir is one of my principal joys. And a fellow who was living in my house, he used to go off in periodic toots,…
